info.title: Flash sale API
info.description: Generated from the route table of @flash/contract. Do not edit it by hand: run `npm run openapi:generate`.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. It checks no dependency.
Readiness: Postgres and Redis both answer.

503.description: Not ready, or the hold cannot be taken now

get.summary: The sale a shopper sees: the one that opens last.
Live sale status as Server-Sent Events (event `sale`).
Live place in the queue as Server-Sent Events (event `place`).

post.summary: Join the waiting queue. The reply holds the ticket.

409.description: The sale or the hold does not allow it

get.summary: Check a place in the queue. Needs the ticket.

post.summary: Hold one item for the sale's hold time. Needs the ticket.

409.description: The sale or the hold does not allow it

503.description: Not ready, or the hold cannot be taken now

post.summary: Pay for the held item. Sending it again is safe.

409.description: The sale or the hold does not allow it

post.summary: Create a sale. Needs the admin token; refuses a window that overlaps another sale.

409.description: The sale or the hold does not allow it

get.summary: Did I get it? A purchase, a live hold, or nothing.
